title: PCG, Navy, Marines drive away Chinese ship, 22 ‘sampans’ from PH territorial waters

blocks.text: The Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) led a joint operation with the Philippine Navy and the Philippine Marine Corps to drive away a Chinese maritime militia vessel and 22 sampans within the territorial sea of Kota Island in the Kalayaan Island Group (KIG) on Friday.
